title: Law to raise income limit for senior and disabled rent exemption
summary: This bill would raise the maximum household income allowed to qualify for the Senior Citizen Rent Increase Exemption and Disability Rent Increase Exemption programs to $75,000, beginning July 1, 2026. It would also align the definition of income used for eligibility with New York State law. The change applies retroactively to July 1, 2026.
